lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines with relatively uniform inter-line spacing; a slight increase in density is observed in the mid-posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Minor Y-shaped bifurcation visible at the ventral terminus of the 3rd anterior line; lines 11 and 12 converge toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 12th lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 4 high-contrast spots on the lower posterior haunch, with 2 additional distinct spots on the mid-hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots on the zygomatic/cheek region; white patch on the lower neck; distinct white bands on the distal portions of the limbs.
